hints.title: Zero Multiplicity
hints.text: Zeros add nothing to the sum, so if there are c zeros in nums, every valid sub-multiset can include between 0 and c zeros, multiplying ways by c + 1.

hints.title: Distinct Items Bounded Knapsack
hints.text: Group identical positive numbers. Distinct non-zero values sum to at most sum(nums), limiting distinct count to at most sqrt(2 * sum).

hints.title: Sliding Window Optimization
hints.text: For each distinct value x with frequency c, use a sliding window over residue classes modulo x to update dp[j] in O(r) time.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: sum: sum of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Bounded knapsack using residue class sliding window prefix sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard 0/1 knapsack takes O(n * r), which times out for large n.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply bounded knapsack sliding window optimization over distinct values.
